# Spec addendum: functional tests

Part of the specification: every test of tier `functional`, from the test registry. The adapter contract, the languages, the types and the other tiers are in [SPEC-TESTS.md](SPEC-TESTS.md).

**Tier functional:** uses a real thing: a compiler or VM, a toolchain, generated code built and run; per pull request on runners that provide it.

Functional tests every language answers: 36. Language-free tests: 66.

Run this tier for a language with `schema-test run --tier functional --lang L`, one test with `schema-test run <full name>`.

## Tests every language answers

Each test's full name for language `L` is `L.functional.<type>.<family>.<case>`: every language in the registry has this instance, unless the registry declares it unrepresentable there (listed at the end of this page). The language's adapter receives the inputs as written in the registry row and must establish the expected result.

## Language-free tests

Each runs once, as `none.functional.<type>.<family>.<case>`, through the adapter its row names. A new language implements none of these; they hold the compiler, the corpora and the harness itself.
